Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 20, 2026 · DepositCam by Wade Foundry

DepositCam (“the App”) is an Android app that helps renters document the condition of a rental with timestamped, GPS-stamped photos and a PDF report. This policy explains what data is used and where it goes.

Delete your data

On your device: Walkthroughs and photos stay on your phone by default. To delete them:

  • Uninstall DepositCam from your Android device, or
  • Open Android Settings → Apps → DepositCam → Storage and tap Clear storage / Clear data.

Either action removes walkthroughs, photos, captions, notes, and the local unlock flag for that install.

Optional cloud account: If you created a DepositCam Cloud account, you can delete it and the associated cloud data in two ways:

  • In the App: Account → Delete account & cloud data.
  • Without the App: email support@depositcam.com from the address you signed in with, and ask us to delete your DepositCam account. We will remove your cloud PDFs, walkthrough photo backups, and account profile.

Google Play purchase and subscription records remain with Google under Google’s policies. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Google account / Play subscriptions page. Local walkthroughs on a phone stay until you clear app data or uninstall.

Data stored on your device

Walkthroughs, stamped photos, captions, notes, optional GPS coordinates on those photos, SHA-256 photo fingerprints, and your one-time PDF unlock status are saved on your device by default.

  • Uninstalling the App removes walkthroughs, photos, and unlock status stored in that install.
  • We cannot restore data that was only stored on your device.
  • If you turn on “Save photos to gallery,” a copy of each stamped photo is written to your device album. DepositCam does not read your existing photo library.

Optional account and DepositCam Cloud

An account is not required for core DepositCam features. If you choose DepositCam Cloud (a Google Play subscription), you may sign in with email magic link or Google. We then store, in private cloud storage operated for us by Supabase:

  • Your account email.
  • Finished PDF reports you explicitly save to Cloud.
  • Walkthrough backups you explicitly upload — stamped photos, captions, property details, and any GPS coordinates already on those photos — so you can restore them on another device.

We do not upload walkthroughs or PDFs unless you choose those Cloud actions while signed in with an active subscription. We do not use this data for advertising, and we do not sell it.

Camera, location, and notifications

The App asks for camera access to take room photos. Photos stay on your device unless you later back up that walkthrough to Cloud.

The App may ask for location so GPS coordinates can be burned into photo pixels and stored with the walkthrough. Location is requested in the foreground when you take a photo, after an in-app explanation. You can skip GPS and still use the App; photos will be timestamped without coordinates. Location is not sent to Wade Foundry unless you back up that walkthrough to Cloud.

If you set a move-out date, the App may ask for notification permission so it can remind you to photograph the property before you hand back the keys. Reminders are scheduled on your device. You can refuse notifications and still use the App.

Payments

Optional PDF export unlock is a one-time purchase processed by Google Play Billing. Optional DepositCam Cloud is a monthly or yearly subscription, also billed through Google Play. Google handles your payment method. We do not receive or store your full card number. After a successful one-time purchase (or restore), the App stores an unlock flag on your device. Cloud entitlement is tied to your signed-in account after Play verifies the subscription.

Analytics

The App does not use third-party advertising trackers. We do not sell your personal information.

Third-party services

  • App distribution and in-app purchases / subscriptions: Google Play
  • Optional account auth and private Cloud storage (PDFs and walkthrough backups): Supabase, on our behalf
  • This privacy policy page is hosted as a static page so Google Play can link to it

Google processes payment data under Google’s own privacy policies.

Children

DepositCam is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we do. Continued use of the App after an update means you accept the revised policy.

Contact

Questions about this policy, or a request to delete your cloud account: support@depositcam.com.
